**sdd/issue-253-b1/proposal — Track B B1 pure wiring + complete-ready co-promotion**

**What**: Proposal for SDD change issue-253-b1 (Track B / B1 — the wiring). Written to openspec/changes/issue-253-b1/proposal.md on branch feat/issue-253-b1.

**Why**: B0 (#250, MERGED #252) shipped sdd-layout.mjs accessor + sealed LEGACY_GRANDFATHERED + drift-guard(A1+A2) + rehearsal tests, DELIBERATELY UNCONSUMED. B1 makes the gates READ it. Built on the 3 owner pins (#595): Pin A pure wiring + real-corpus golden proof; Pin B complete-ready co-promotion branch (human open+merge only); Pin C the instruction-emission adapter is B2's (out of B1).

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-253-b1/proposal.md

**Deliverables**:
- A (4 items): wire 6 sites onto accessor (check-refs.mjs:96-112→missingRequiredArtifacts+isGrandfathered; session-start.mjs:38-69→parseChangeId+CHANGES_ROOT; phase-order-check.mjs→isGrandfathered/LEGACY_GRANDFATHERED; new-change.mjs:48-110→changeDir+artifactPaths; engram.mjs:804-805&925-926→changeDir+OPERATIONAL_ARTIFACTS; feature-resolution.mjs:37-81→changeDir/CHANGES_ROOT+OPERATIONAL_ARTIFACTS); swap BASELINE_EXEMPT_DIRS→import LEGACY_GRANDFATHERED; add drift-guard A3 (consumers reference module); slug fix in new-change.mjs (issue-<N>-<slug> mandatory). Spec.md emission already landed via #251.
- B: complete-ready co-promotion branch — ADR-0019 (Status:Accepted+banner+ISO date+number re-verified vs brain/project/decisions/ AND brain-drafts/) promoted to brain/project/decisions/adr-0019-harness-port.md; sdd-layout.md moved brain-drafts→brain/core/methodology/; HOME.md+HOME.template.md nav entries (travel atomically — brain:nav fails if doc exists without nav entry). Human opens+merges; agent NEVER opens/merges.

**Golden-capture mechanism (recommended)**: corpus-capture harness walks every openspec/changes/* dir (~27), serializes each gate verdict to deterministic sorted JSON; BEFORE snapshot captured from pre-wiring tree + committed as golden fixture; post-wiring test regenerates + deepEqual asserts diff=ZERO. Synthetic edge fixtures additionally.

**Co-promotion delivery (recommended)**: dedicated branch off same base as B1 (feature/v2.0.0 post-B0), doc-zone promotion + nav edits only, pushed but NOT opened by agent. Beats patch file / folding into B1 PR.

**Non-goals**: B2 (instruction-emission adapter + Antigravity baptism, #247), B3 (deferred), any change to sealed set, VALID_OPS expansion, promotedSpecPath (E1).

**Acceptance/CP-B1**: byte-identical gate output over real corpus; A3 green; co-promotion branch complete-and-ready; ≤400 lines no size:exception; TDD (golden capture first); npm test/brain:repo:check/brain:nav/brain:change:verify green; STOP at CP-B1.

**Learned**: 3 residual forks (pins nailed most scope): F1 golden-capture snapshot format (JSON fixture vs stash dual-run — recommend fixture); F2 A3 grep shape (ship B0-staged shape); F3 co-promotion delivery (branch off base — recommend). Next: sdd-spec + sdd-design (parallel).
